text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- New stock exchange headquarters, extension of French-Italian SGS Thomson electronics site in Casablanca confirm Morocco's position as emerging market.
- Jerusalem committee to meet in Morocco on Thursday.
- Communications Minister M'daghri in Spain to expand cooperation on information.
- Talk of dissolving National Tourism Office, in charge of promoting Morocco for about 40 years, for bad management.
- Surging sea prevents fixing of last cable to connect Spain and Morocco electricity grids.
- Morocco has up to 30,000 tuberculosis cases each year.
- Moroccan Organisation of Human Rights holds three-day meeting starting March 28.
- State-owned airline Royal Air Maroc starts discount prices for Moroccan expatriates who tend to use cheaper flights to return home.
